title: Every Good Thing Comes From God
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delves into the importance of giving and receiving God's blessings in your life. In this powerful message, he'll help you understand that every good thing in your life comes from God, and that you're simply a steward of what He's given you. Get ready to be challenged to let go of attachment and trust God with your resources, and discover how His blessings can transform your life forever.
